title: Phone: StatusGrid Restart Failed, and LC-0412 Is Now Immediate

transcript.speaker: MEDCOM
transcript.text: LRMC MEDCOM.

transcript.speaker: StatusGrid
transcript.text: Hey, it's StatusGrid again. Bad news. I pushed the restart at 19:33. It came up, replayed the 16:55 queue like I warned you, and then StatusSync dropped again at 19:34. Same exit code, 1067.

transcript.speaker: StatusGrid
transcript.text: So right now your board shows Pinecrest OPEN with 5 beds, and St. Brendan's OPEN with 8, no CT flag. Both of those are wrong. Those are the old values from before the crash.

transcript.speaker: StatusGrid
transcript.text: I'll try again at 19:50, but honestly, I can't promise it'll hold. The field tech is still about two and a half hours out. Anything on that page right now, I wouldn't trust it.

transcript.speaker: Transportation (MED 1)
transcript.text: MEDCOM, Transportation, on MED 1.

transcript.speaker: Transportation (MED 1)
transcript.text: Tag LC-0412, 61-year-old male, was Delayed. Triage just reassessed him. Respirations 34, so he's now Immediate.

transcript.speaker: Transportation (MED 1)
transcript.text: Tamarack Medic 12 is loaded, and the crew's tablet says St. Brendan's is Open. Do I roll him there, or do we wait for you to confirm every hospital?

transcript.speaker: Transportation (MED 1)
transcript.text: I've got three other Immediates and four Minor patients sitting out here in the rain. I need a destination, MEDCOM.

transcript.speaker: StatusGrid
transcript.text: Sounds like you've got your hands full. Do you want me to leave the board up while I work on it, or take the page offline so nobody's reading it? Your call.

transcript.speaker: MEDCOM
transcript.text: Stand by, both of you.

voiceStyles.Transportation (MED 1): Man in his 50s, paramedic outdoors in heavy rain, diesel engines idling nearby, urgent but controlled

instructorNote: This is a decision point. MEDCOM, the Coalition Coordinator and the Medical Group must either declare the board unreliable and run every destination by voice roll call on MED 1 every 15 minutes (slower, uses up staff and MED 1), or keep using the board with phone spot checks and risk another patient going to the wrong hospital. Either way, watch that LC-0412's destination is confirmed by voice before Medic 12 leaves (St. Brendan's is Limited intake and LRMC is full) and that the new Immediate count (now 4 on scene) is logged and sent to the IC.
